value.rationale: The finite-sample variance of ordinary triangle motif counts is a central observable in spherical geometric graph detection. Exact all-d variance and an everywhere strict dimension ordering sharpen existing one-sided variance/mean bounds; a positive d^-1/2 coefficient quantitatively calibrates excess motif noise. The exact d=2 covariance 29/768 and d=3 closed form make the theorem directly usable.
